_comment: Automatic Munyun Machine — user config. Copy to config.json (which is gitignored) and edit. Run /update on the bot to pick up changes without restart.

user._comment: Filled in during setup. salaryFloorUsd 0 = no floor; maxYoeAcceptable 100 = effectively no cap (setup asks for real values).

_queriesComment: Left EMPTY on a fresh install — setup fills these from YOUR resume (role-suggester), so the app is never pre-tailored to someone else's field. Add/remove terms anytime from the dashboard Searches page or the bot's /jobs add. With zero queries the batch is empty until you add some (that is intentional — no jobs beats wrong-field jobs).

search._comment: v2.0.3: what /jobs suggest and wizard step 5 propose. titles (default) = full job titles like 'IAM Engineer' — precise searches. keywords = short domain terms like 'iam', 'm365', 'linux' — broader nets; the CV-match scorer and matchFloorPercent handle precision. Switch anytime from the bot: /jobs mode titles|keywords. The scraper itself just searches whatever strings are in queries[].
search._workplaceTypesValues: v5.0: which workplace arrangements to search. Any of: Remote, Hybrid, On-Site. Default ['Remote'] (unchanged from earlier versions). Pick from dashboard Settings; e.g. ['On-Site','Hybrid'] for local jobs, or all three for everything.
search._locationComment: v5.0: optional location (city, state, or country) applied to your search — most useful with On-Site/Hybrid. Empty = no location constraint (nationwide/global).

sources._comment: v5.0: pull jobs straight from company ATS job boards (public, official feeds) IN ADDITION to hiring.cafe — no login, no scraping, more reliable. OFF until you list companies. Each entry is the board token from a company's careers URL: greenhouse boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, lever jobs.lever.co/<token>, ashby jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>. Add them from the dashboard Searches page.
sources._diceComment: v7.3: pull jobs from dice.com using your configured search terms (no login, no key). Toggle from the dashboard Searches page. Salary ranges come structured; top results per term get full-JD scoring. Optional Dice sign-in (System page) makes apply links open logged in. search.scrapeSources picks what runs: both | hcafe | dice; each queries[] entry may carry engines: both | hcafe | dice to route a single term.
sources._remoteConfigUrlComment: v5.0: optional URL to a JSON file (e.g. a GitHub raw link) that can add source companies / adapter tweaks remotely, so a site change is a same-day fix without an app update. Empty = off. Fetched read-only, cached, and merged over local sources.

filters._filterClearanceComment: Default off (v5.0) — when on, drops jobs requiring a security clearance OR US citizenship. That is the right filter only for some users, so a fresh install includes everything and you opt in from Settings.
filters._applicationFormEaseValues: all (default) | simple (only Simple Apps - no account creation) | long (only Time Consuming Apps)
filters._maxJobAgeValues: v2.5: how recent a job must be, filtered on the posted-age shown on each hiring.cafe card. today | 3days | week | month | any (default, no age filter). Also accepts a raw number of days. Set from the dashboard's Recency dropdown.
filters._skipCompaniesComment: Companies to never show — add your own from the dashboard Searches page or the bot's /skip. Empty by default (v5.0).
filters._dropTitlePatternsComment: Case-insensitive title substrings to drop before scoring (e.g. add 'Manager' if you only want individual-contributor roles, or 'Intern'). Empty by default (v5.0) so no job class is silently hidden; tune from the dashboard Searches page.

scoring._matchFloorComment: Drop jobs below this match% before the top-100 cut. v1.0 E3. /floor 0 disables; /floor 50 picks only strong matches.
scoring._maxPagesPerQueryComment: Hiring.cafe shows ~40 cards per page. Bot clicks Next up to this many times per query. Effective ceiling — per-query early-stop on '0 new cards' usually terminates much sooner.
scoring._targetJobsPerBatchComment: How many ranked jobs make the final batch (top-N after scoring). Dashboard Settings offers 50/100/150/200; other values snap to the nearest of those. Larger batches resolve more apply-URL pages (slower) and, when signed in, mark more jobs Viewed on your hiring.cafe account.
scoring._searchAllQueriesComment: v2.3: true (default) = search EVERY keyword, fully paginated to maxPagesPerQuery, so jobs under later keywords are never missed. false = old behavior: stop scraping more keywords once ~1.5x targetJobsPerBatch candidates are found (faster, but can skip keywords).
scoring._seenJobsFreshnessComment: Days before an unapplied previously-seen job rolls back into the supply pool. Applied jobs (in applications.md) are always blocked.
scoring._accountDedupComment: v4.3: when signed in to hiring.cafe, the scrape asks the server to hide Saved/Applied/Viewed jobs (searchState.hideJobTypes) - dedup that lives on your account and follows you across computers. Signed out (or set false) AMM falls back to the local seen-jobs memory above.
scoring._aiComment: v4.0: jdRescore = rescore shortlisted jobs on the full posting text (default true). mutedTerms = terms the scorer must ignore (set from the dashboard Why panel). ai = optional Smart match rerank: paste your own Anthropic API key in the dashboard Settings; off by default; key stays local in this file.

display._showSalaryComment: v4.6: show the salary parsed from each posting (e.g. ~$140k) on the dashboard job list. Toggle from Settings. Salary is best-effort — many postings don't list one, and those rows simply show no badge. Your VA's link-only file is unaffected.

browser._comment: v2.0.1: which browser the scraper drives. auto (default) = installed Google Chrome, then Microsoft Edge, then Playwright's downloaded Chromium. Force with channel: chrome | msedge, or point executablePath at any Chromium-family binary (Brave, distro chromium). AMM always uses its own profile in data/browser-profile - your personal browsing is never touched.

weather._comment: v5.0: optional 'good morning' weather line. Empty city = weather skipped. Setup geocodes your city and sets lat/lon/timezone; tempUnit is fahrenheit | celsius.

email._comment: Email the job batch to someone (e.g. a virtual assistant). 'format' (v7.0) = the saved attachment type (txt | csv | xlsx) used by the automatic morning send AND as the default for manual sends; the dashboard's Email menu can still override per-send. Connect Gmail through Google's consent screen with send-only permission; App Password SMTP remains an advanced fallback. OAuth tokens and SMTP credentials stay local and never live in config.json. 'to' = recipient; 'autoSend' emails automatically after each morning scrape; {DATE} in 'subject' expands to the batch date.
email.subject: Job batch — {DATE}
